sample.replication: Prolific, UK residents 18+; stage 2 pooled sample 247 analysed, 345 excluded (58% failed comprehension)
sample.stages: sequential design: Stage 1 (N = 113 analysed, 161 excluded) 'c2(3)=4.21, p=.239, Cramer's V=.19', not significant, so Stage 2 data were collected; Stage 1 is a subset of the pooled Stage 2 sample (N = 247) used for every target. The Stage 1 interim test is recorded here only and is not scored (report p. 1)

assignment.what: Role (Butcher/Baker) and Knowledge (1-4) set by two Qualtrics randomisers, each 'Randomly present 1 of the following elements' with 'Evenly Present Elements' checked, after the Task Explanation block

pages.what: Consent block (information + consent choice); 'I DO NOT consent' ends the survey (flow 1)
HOT DOG PRICE + example boxes (picture) + 'It is now time'
Decision block, question 2 (piped choice + text box)

arms.n_note: recruited across stage 1 and 2 batches: 247 analysed + 345 excluded (report p. 2)

fields.together: None if answer('decision.choice') is None else (1 if answer('decision.choice') == 'together' else 0)
fields.pay_correct: 1 if (answer('comp1.q1') == '1.80' and answer('comp1.q2') == '0' and answer('comp1.q3') == '1.60') else 0

exclusions.if: answer('consent.consent') != 'yes' or answer('decision.choice') is None or not (answer('comp1.q1') == '1.80' and answer('comp1.q2') == '0' and answer('comp1.q3') == '1.60')
